PAN.shortDescription: Get your Permanent Account Number issued by the Income Tax Department, required for taxation, banking, and financial transactions.
PAN.longDescription: PAN is a unique 10-digit alphanumeric identifier mandatory for filing income tax returns, opening bank accounts, and undertaking most financial transactions in India. We handle document verification, Form 49A/49AA preparation, online submission, and delivery of the e-PAN and physical card.
features: Instant e-PAN and physical card delivery

process.title: Document Collection
process.description: Submit identity, address, and DOB proofs.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: We prepare and submit Form 49A/49AA online.

process.title: PAN Delivery
process.description: e-PAN emailed instantly; physical card dispatched.

faqs.question: Who needs a PAN?
faqs.answer: Anyone earning taxable income or conducting specified high-value financial transactions in India.

faqs.question: Can a minor apply for PAN?
faqs.answer: Yes, through a parent or guardian using the minor's proof of identity.

faqs.question: How long is PAN valid?
faqs.answer: PAN has lifetime validity and does not need renewal.

TAN.shortDescription: Obtain your Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number, mandatory for deducting or collecting tax at source.
TAN.longDescription: TAN is required for any person or entity responsible for deducting or collecting TDS/TCS and filing related returns. We handle Form 49B preparation, submission, and TAN allotment tracking so you can start deducting tax compliantly.
benefits: Avoids penalty for non-possession of TAN

process.title: Document Collection
process.description: Collect PAN and address proof of the deductor entity.

process.title: Form 49B Filing
process.description: Prepare and submit application to NSDL.

process.title: TAN Allotment
process.description: Receive TAN allotment letter and certificate.

faqs.question: Who must obtain TAN?
faqs.answer: Any person responsible for deducting or collecting tax at source.

faqs.question: Can one entity hold multiple TANs?
faqs.answer: Generally one TAN per deductor, though separate branches can apply separately.

faqs.question: Is TAN different from PAN?
faqs.answer: Yes, TAN is for TDS/TCS compliance while PAN is for general tax identification.

GST Registration.shortDescription: Complete assistance in obtaining GST registration so you can legally collect tax, claim input credit, and issue GST-compliant invoices.
GST Registration.longDescription: GST registration is mandatory once turnover or activity thresholds are crossed. We handle eligibility assessment, document preparation, ARN tracking, and clarification replies to get your GSTIN issued smoothly.
benefits: Legally collect GST and claim ITC
requirements: Address proof of place of business

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Assess registration requirement and category.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit GST REG-01 with documents on the portal.

process.title: GSTIN Issuance
process.description: Respond to queries, if any, and receive GSTIN.

faqs.question: Who must register for GST?
faqs.answer: Businesses crossing the prescribed turnover threshold or engaged in specified supplies.

faqs.question: Is GST registration state-wise?
faqs.answer: Yes, a separate GSTIN is required for each state of operation.

faqs.question: Can I register voluntarily?
faqs.answer: Yes, voluntary registration is allowed even below the threshold.

Udyam (MSME) Registration.shortDescription: Register your micro, small, or medium enterprise under Udyam to access government schemes, subsidies, and credit benefits.
Udyam (MSME) Registration.longDescription: Udyam Registration officially classifies your enterprise as MSME, unlocking priority-sector lending, subsidies, tender preference, and delayed-payment protection. We handle Aadhaar-based filing and certificate issuance.

process.title: Detail Collection
process.description: Gather Aadhaar, PAN, and business details.

process.title: Online Filing
process.description: Submit application on the Udyam portal.

process.title: Certificate Issuance
process.description: Receive Udyam registration certificate.

faqs.question: Is Udyam registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: It is optional but strongly recommended to access MSME benefits.

faqs.question: Does classification change over time?
faqs.answer: Yes, based on updated investment and turnover figures each year.

faqs.question: Is there a renewal requirement?
faqs.answer: No renewal is needed; details are self-updated as they change.

Company Registration.shortDescription: Incorporate your private limited, public, or one-person company with complete documentation and MCA filing support.
Company Registration.longDescription: Company registration establishes a separate legal entity with limited liability and perpetual succession. We manage name approval, DIN/DSC, MOA/AOA drafting, and MCA filing through to certificate of incorporation.
requirements: Identity and address proof of directors

process.title: Name Reservation
process.description: Reserve company name via SPICe+ Part A.

process.title: Document Drafting
process.description: Prepare MOA, AOA, and SPICe+ Part B forms.

process.title: Incorporation Filing
process.description: File with MCA and receive incorporation certificate.

faqs.question: What is the minimum number of directors?
faqs.answer: Two for a private limited company, one for an OPC.

faqs.question: Is a physical office required?
faqs.answer: A registered office address proof is required but can be residential.

faqs.question: What is included in incorporation?
faqs.answer: PAN, TAN, and DIN are auto-generated along with the incorporation certificate.

LLP Registration.shortDescription: Set up a Limited Liability Partnership combining partnership flexibility with limited liability protection.
LLP Registration.longDescription: LLP registration creates a separate legal entity with limited liability for partners while retaining operational flexibility. We handle DPIN, name reservation, LLP agreement drafting, and MCA incorporation filing.

process.title: Name Reservation
process.description: Reserve LLP name through the MCA portal.

process.title: Agreement Drafting
process.description: Draft the LLP agreement defining rights and duties.

process.title: Incorporation
process.description: File FiLLiP form and receive certificate of incorporation.

faqs.question: How many partners are required?
faqs.answer: A minimum of two partners, with no upper limit.

faqs.question: Is an LLP agreement mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, it must be filed within 30 days of incorporation.

faqs.question: Can an LLP raise equity funding?
faqs.answer: LLPs cannot issue shares, making them less suited for equity fundraising.

Partnership Firm Registration.shortDescription: Formally register your partnership firm to establish partner rights, business credibility, and legal documentation.
Partnership Firm Registration.longDescription: Partnership firm registration records the partnership deed with the Registrar of Firms, providing legal recognition useful for banking, contracts, and dispute resolution. We draft the deed and handle registration filing.

process.title: Deed Drafting
process.description: Draft the partnership deed with agreed terms.

process.title: Registration Filing
process.description: File the deed with the Registrar of Firms.

process.title: PAN & Bank Setup
process.description: Apply for firm PAN and assist with bank account.

faqs.question: Is partnership registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: It is optional but recommended for legal enforceability of rights.

faqs.question: Can an unregistered firm sue third parties?
faqs.answer: An unregistered firm faces restrictions in enforcing contracts through courts.

faqs.question: How many partners can a firm have?
faqs.answer: Up to 50 partners as per the Companies Act rules.

Shops & Establishment Registration.shortDescription: Register your commercial establishment under state Shops & Establishment laws covering employment and working conditions.
Shops & Establishment Registration.longDescription: This registration is mandatory for most commercial establishments and regulates working hours, holidays, wages, and employee records. We handle application preparation and submission with the local labour department.
benefits: Required for bank account and licenses

process.title: Document Collection
process.description: Gather premises and owner details.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application to the local authority.

process.title: Certificate Receipt
process.description: Receive registration certificate.

faqs.question: Who needs this registration?
faqs.answer: Nearly all shops, offices, and commercial establishments employing staff.

faqs.question: Does it need renewal?
faqs.answer: Yes, most states require periodic renewal, typically annually or every few years.

faqs.question: Is it different across states?
faqs.answer: Yes, rules and forms vary by state labour department.

Trade Licence.shortDescription: Obtain a municipal trade licence authorizing your business to operate within local health, safety, and zoning norms.
Trade Licence.longDescription: A trade licence is issued by the local municipal body permitting specified commercial activities. We assist with application preparation, inspection coordination, and licence issuance follow-up.

process.title: Document Preparation
process.description: Compile premises and business documents.

process.title: Application Submission
process.description: File application with the municipal corporation.

process.title: Inspection & Approval
process.description: Coordinate inspection and obtain licence.

faqs.question: Is trade licence the same nationwide?
faqs.answer: No, requirements vary by municipal corporation.

faqs.question: How often must it be renewed?
faqs.answer: Typically annually, depending on the local authority.

faqs.question: What happens without a trade licence?
faqs.answer: The business risks fines, sealing of premises, or forced closure.

Professional Tax Registration.shortDescription: Register for professional tax to comply with state-level deduction, payment, and return-filing requirements.
Professional Tax Registration.longDescription: Professional tax registration applies to employers and certain professionals in states that levy it. We handle enrolment certificate and registration certificate applications, along with ongoing return guidance.

process.title: Applicability Check
process.description: Determine state-specific PT applicability and slabs.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit registration application to the PT department.

process.title: Certificate Issuance
process.description: Receive registration certificate.

faqs.question: Is professional tax applicable in all states?
faqs.answer: No, only in states that have enacted a professional tax law.

faqs.question: Who deducts professional tax?
faqs.answer: Employers deduct it from employee salaries and deposit it with the state.

faqs.question: Is there a maximum PT amount?
faqs.answer: Yes, capped at ₹2,500 per person per year under law.

FSSAI Registration/License.shortDescription: Get your food business legally authorized with FSSAI registration or licensing based on scale and turnover.
FSSAI Registration/License.longDescription: FSSAI registration or licence is mandatory for food businesses to ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and quality standards. We assess the applicable category and manage documentation through approval.

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Determine basic, state, or central licence category.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit form and documents on the FoSCoS portal.

process.title: Approval & Certificate
process.description: Track application and receive certificate.

faqs.question: Who needs FSSAI registration?
faqs.answer: Any entity manufacturing, storing, distributing, or selling food products.

faqs.question: What determines basic vs state vs central?
faqs.answer: Annual turnover and scale of operations.

faqs.question: How long is the licence valid?
faqs.answer: One to five years, as chosen at the time of application.

Import Export Code (IEC).shortDescription: Obtain your Import Export Code, the mandatory identification number for cross-border trade transactions.
Import Export Code (IEC).longDescription: IEC is required to import or export goods and services and to complete customs and banking formalities. We handle DGFT application filing and digital IEC certificate issuance.

process.title: Document Collection
process.description: Gather PAN, bank, and address proofs.

process.title: Online Filing
process.description: Submit application on the DGFT portal.

process.title: IEC Issuance
process.description: Receive digital IEC certificate.

faqs.question: Is IEC required for service exports?
faqs.answer: Only if availing benefits under Foreign Trade Policy; otherwise mostly for goods.

faqs.question: Does IEC need renewal?
faqs.answer: Annual online updation is required even if there is no change.

faqs.question: Can individuals apply for IEC?
faqs.answer: Yes, proprietors can obtain IEC in their individual capacity.

Startup India Recognition.shortDescription: Get your startup recognized under Startup India to access tax benefits, funding support, and regulatory relaxations.
Startup India Recognition.longDescription: Startup India recognition is available to eligible innovative entities and unlocks tax exemptions, self-certification, and access to government funds. We prepare the application and supporting documentation.
features: Application drafting on Startup India portal
benefits: Access to Fund of Funds schemes

process.title: Eligibility Review
process.description: Confirm entity age, turnover, and innovation criteria.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit recognition application with write-up.

process.title: Recognition Certificate
process.description: Receive DPIIT recognition certificate.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for Startup India?
faqs.answer: Entities under 10 years old with turnover below the prescribed limit and innovative operations.

faqs.question: Is tax exemption automatic?
faqs.answer: No, a separate application under Section 80-IAC is needed after recognition.

faqs.question: Can an LLP apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, private companies and LLPs are both eligible.

DPIIT Recognition.shortDescription: Secure DPIIT recognition for your startup to unlock regulatory relaxations, tax benefits, and procurement advantages.
DPIIT Recognition.longDescription: DPIIT recognition identifies genuinely innovative startups eligible for government schemes, IPR fast-tracking, and public procurement relaxations. We manage the online application and evidence submission.
requirements: Website or product details, if available

process.title: Documentation
process.description: Prepare innovation and scalability evidence.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit on the DPIIT recognition portal.

process.title: Recognition Approval
process.description: Track and secure DPIIT approval.

faqs.question: Is DPIIT same as Startup India recognition?
faqs.answer: Yes, DPIIT recognition is the formal name for Startup India certification.

faqs.question: Can recognition be revoked?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the entity is found not to meet the eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Is there a fee for the application?
faqs.answer: The government application itself is free; charges cover professional assistance.

Trademark Registration.shortDescription: Protect your brand name, logo, or mark with complete trademark application and registration support.
Trademark Registration.longDescription: Trademark registration grants exclusive rights over your brand identity and strengthens legal recourse against infringement. We handle search, application filing, examination responses, and registration follow-up.

process.title: Trademark Search
process.description: Check availability and conflicting marks.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: File application with the Trademark Registry.

process.title: Examination & Registration
process.description: Respond to objections and secure registration.

faqs.question: How long does registration take?
faqs.answer: Typically 12-18 months if there are no objections or oppositions.

faqs.question: Can I use TM before registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, the TM symbol can be used once the application is filed.

faqs.question: How long is a trademark valid?
faqs.answer: 10 years, renewable indefinitely.

EPFO Registration.shortDescription: Register your establishment with EPFO to comply with provident fund contribution and reporting requirements.
EPFO Registration.longDescription: EPFO registration is mandatory for eligible establishments to enrol employees, deduct contributions, and file periodic returns. We manage application filing and employer code allotment.
features: Online application via Shram Suvidha portal

process.title: Applicability Check
process.description: Confirm employee threshold requiring registration.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit registration on the EPFO portal.

process.title: Code Allotment
process.description: Receive establishment code and login credentials.

faqs.question: When is EPFO registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: Once an establishment employs 20 or more persons.

faqs.question: Can smaller firms register voluntarily?
faqs.answer: Yes, voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold.

faqs.question: What is the contribution rate?
faqs.answer: 12% of basic wages each from employer and employee, subject to applicable rules.

ESIC Registration.shortDescription: Register under ESIC to provide statutory medical and cash benefits to your eligible employees.
ESIC Registration.longDescription: ESIC registration is mandatory for establishments crossing the prescribed employee threshold, providing medical and social security benefits. We manage application filing and code allotment.

process.title: Applicability Check
process.description: Confirm employee threshold and wage ceiling.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit registration on the ESIC portal.

process.title: Code Allotment
process.description: Receive employer code and login access.

faqs.question: When is ESIC mandatory?
faqs.answer: Once an establishment employs 10 or more persons, subject to state rules.

faqs.question: What is the wage ceiling for coverage?
faqs.answer: Employees earning up to the prescribed wage limit are covered.

faqs.question: What benefits does ESIC provide?
faqs.answer: Medical care, sickness, maternity, and disability benefits.

Labour/Contract Labour Registration.shortDescription: Comply with contract labour regulations through principal employer registration and contractor licensing support.
Labour/Contract Labour Registration.longDescription: Establishments engaging contract workers must register as principal employers, and contractors must obtain licences. We manage documentation, filings, and ongoing compliance records.

process.title: Applicability Review
process.description: Assess contract labour threshold and requirements.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: File registration/licence application with labour department.

process.title: Certificate Issuance
process.description: Receive registration/licence certificate.

faqs.question: Who needs this registration?
faqs.answer: Establishments engaging 20 or more contract workers, subject to state rules.

faqs.question: Do contractors also need a licence?
faqs.answer: Yes, contractors supplying such workers require a separate licence.

faqs.question: Is renewal required?
faqs.answer: Yes, periodic renewal is mandated by most state rules.

Factory Licence.shortDescription: Obtain a factory licence to legally operate manufacturing premises under occupational safety and welfare norms.
Factory Licence.longDescription: A factory licence certifies compliance with safety, health, and welfare standards for manufacturing units employing power or a threshold number of workers. We manage application, inspection coordination, and approval.

process.title: Document Preparation
process.description: Compile building plan and machinery details.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application to the factories department.

process.title: Inspection & Licence
process.description: Coordinate inspection and secure licence.

faqs.question: When is a factory licence required?
faqs.answer: For premises using power with 10+ workers, or 20+ without power.

faqs.question: Is renewal needed?
faqs.answer: Yes, typically on an annual basis.

faqs.question: What happens without a licence?
faqs.answer: Risk of penalties, prosecution, or forced closure of operations.

Fire NOC.shortDescription: Secure a Fire NOC confirming your premises meet fire-safety norms, exits, and emergency equipment requirements.
Fire NOC.longDescription: Fire NOC is required for occupancy or operational approval of commercial, industrial, or high-rise premises. We coordinate documentation, site preparation guidance, and inspection with the fire department.

process.title: Site Assessment
process.description: Review layout and existing fire-safety measures.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit NOC application with documents.

process.title: Inspection & NOC
process.description: Coordinate inspection and obtain NOC.

faqs.question: Who requires a Fire NOC?
faqs.answer: Commercial buildings, factories, and high-occupancy premises as per state rules.

faqs.question: Is renewal necessary?
faqs.answer: Yes, most authorities require periodic renewal.

faqs.question: What equipment is typically required?
faqs.answer: Fire extinguishers, hydrants, alarms, and marked emergency exits.

Pollution Control Board Consent.shortDescription: Obtain Consent to Establish/Operate from the Pollution Control Board for eligible industrial activities.
Pollution Control Board Consent.longDescription: PCB consent authorizes industrial units after assessing emissions, effluents, and pollution-control measures. We manage category classification, application filing, and coordination with the board.
features: Consent to Establish and Operate filing
benefits: Supports other approvals like factory licence

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Classify industry and applicable consent type.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit consent application with technical details.

process.title: Board Approval
process.description: Coordinate inspection and secure consent order.

faqs.question: What are the industry categories?
faqs.answer: Red, Orange, Green, and White based on pollution potential.

faqs.question: Is consent required before construction?
faqs.answer: Yes, Consent to Establish is needed before setting up the unit.

faqs.question: How often is renewal needed?
faqs.answer: Typically every 1-5 years depending on category and state rules.

Legal Metrology Registration/Approval.shortDescription: Ensure your weighing instruments, measuring equipment, and packaged goods comply with Legal Metrology requirements.
Legal Metrology Registration/Approval.longDescription: Legal Metrology registration covers manufacturers, packers, and dealers of weighing/measuring equipment and pre-packaged commodities. We manage registration, labelling compliance, and verification filings.

process.title: Applicability Review
process.description: Determine category: manufacturer, packer, or dealer.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit registration with the Legal Metrology department.

process.title: Approval & Certificate
process.description: Receive registration certificate.

faqs.question: Who needs Legal Metrology registration?
faqs.answer: Manufacturers, packers, importers, and dealers of weighing/measuring goods.

faqs.question: What labelling details are mandatory?
faqs.answer: MRP, net quantity, manufacturer details, and date of manufacture, among others.

faqs.question: Is renewal required?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration/licence must be renewed periodically.

Drug Licence.shortDescription: Obtain the drug licence required to manufacture, distribute, stock, or sell pharmaceutical products legally.
Drug Licence.longDescription: A drug licence from the State/Central Drug authority ensures compliance with quality, storage, and safety standards for pharmaceutical businesses. We manage documentation, premises requirements, and application follow-up.
benefits: Legal authorization to deal in drugs

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Identify applicable licence type and authority.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application with premises and staff documents.

process.title: Inspection & Approval
process.description: Coordinate inspection and receive licence.

faqs.question: Is a registered pharmacist mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for retail and wholesale drug licences.

faqs.question: What storage conditions are required?
faqs.answer: Adequate space, refrigeration for specified drugs, and proper record-keeping.

faqs.question: Is renewal periodic?
faqs.answer: Yes, drug licences require renewal, typically every few years.

AYUSH Licence.shortDescription: Obtain an AYUSH licence to manufacture or market Ayurvedic, Siddha, Unani, or other AYUSH products compliantly.
AYUSH Licence.longDescription: AYUSH licensing ensures manufacturing and quality standards are met for traditional medicine products. We manage documentation, formulation approval, and application filing with the AYUSH department.
benefits: Builds consumer trust in AYUSH products

process.title: Product Classification
process.description: Classify products under applicable AYUSH categories.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit licence application with technical documents.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Coordinate inspection and secure licence.

faqs.question: Who needs an AYUSH licence?
faqs.answer: Manufacturers and marketers of Ayurvedic, Siddha, Unani, or Homeopathic products.

faqs.question: Is GMP certification required?
faqs.answer: Yes, manufacturing units must comply with GMP standards.

faqs.question: Can the licence cover multiple products?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided each product is listed and approved.

BIS Registration/Certification.shortDescription: Certify your products meet Indian quality standards through BIS registration before manufacture or sale.
BIS Registration/Certification.longDescription: BIS certification demonstrates conformity to prescribed Indian standards for safety, quality, and performance. We manage scheme selection, testing coordination, and application filing.

process.title: Scheme Identification
process.description: Determine applicable BIS scheme for the product.

process.title: Testing & Application
process.description: Coordinate lab testing and file application.

process.title: Audit & Certification
process.description: Factory audit and licence grant.

faqs.question: Which products need BIS certification?
faqs.answer: Products under mandatory BIS-notified categories such as electricals and toys.

faqs.question: Is a factory audit always required?
faqs.answer: Yes, for most product certification schemes.

faqs.question: How long is the licence valid?
faqs.answer: Typically 1-2 years, renewable thereafter.

ISO Certification.shortDescription: Achieve ISO certification demonstrating your organization follows recognized quality or management standards.
ISO Certification.longDescription: ISO certification validates adherence to standards like ISO 9001, 14001, or 27001 for quality, environment, or information security management. We manage gap assessment, documentation, and audit coordination.
features: ISO standard selection and gap assessment

process.title: Gap Assessment
process.description: Review current processes against ISO requirements.

process.title: Documentation
process.description: Prepare manuals, policies, and records.

process.title: Certification Audit
process.description: Coordinate audit and receive certificate.

faqs.question: Which ISO standard should I choose?
faqs.answer: Depends on business needs — ISO 9001 for quality, 27001 for information security, etc.

faqs.question: How long is certification valid?
faqs.answer: Typically 3 years with annual surveillance audits.

faqs.question: Is ISO certification mandatory?
faqs.answer: No, it is voluntary but often required for tenders and larger clients.

RERA Registration.shortDescription: Register your real estate project or agency under RERA to ensure transparency and legal compliance.
RERA Registration.longDescription: RERA registration is mandatory for eligible real estate projects and agents, promoting disclosure, accountability, and buyer protection. We manage documentation and application filing with the state RERA authority.
benefits: Access to RERA dispute resolution mechanism

process.title: Document Compilation
process.description: Gather title, approval, and project documents.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit registration on the RERA portal.

process.title: Registration Approval
process.description: Receive RERA registration number.

faqs.question: Which projects require RERA registration?
faqs.answer: Projects above the prescribed area/unit threshold set by the state.

faqs.question: Do real estate agents also need registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, agents facilitating sale/purchase must register separately.

faqs.question: Is quarterly reporting required?
faqs.answer: Yes, promoters must update project progress periodically.

MCA Registrations/Filings.shortDescription: Stay compliant with statutory MCA filings covering incorporation, annual returns, and company change filings.
MCA Registrations/Filings.longDescription: MCA registrations and filings cover the range of statutory obligations under the Companies Act, from incorporation to periodic and event-based filings. We handle preparation and submission accurately and on time.

process.title: Requirement Assessment
process.description: Identify applicable forms and due dates.

process.title: Form Preparation
process.description: Prepare and verify filing with supporting documents.

process.title: MCA Filing
process.description: Submit filing and confirm acknowledgment.

faqs.question: What filings are commonly required?
faqs.answer: Annual returns, financial statements, and event-based filings like director changes.

faqs.question: What happens on late filing?
faqs.answer: Additional government fees accrue daily until filed.

faqs.question: Is a DSC mandatory for filing?
faqs.answer: Yes, forms must be digitally signed by an authorized signatory.

FEMA/RBI-related Registration/Approval.shortDescription: Ensure compliant cross-border transactions with FEMA and RBI-related registrations and approvals.
FEMA/RBI-related Registration/Approval.longDescription: Foreign investment, overseas investment, and remittance transactions require compliance under FEMA and RBI regulations. We manage filings such as FC-GPR, ODI, and related approvals.

process.title: Transaction Review
process.description: Classify transaction and applicable FEMA provisions.

process.title: Filing Preparation
process.description: Prepare and submit required RBI/FIRMS filings.

process.title: Approval Tracking
process.description: Follow up until acknowledgment/approval.

faqs.question: What is FC-GPR filing?
faqs.answer: A report filed on receipt of foreign investment against share allotment.

faqs.question: Is RBI approval always required?
faqs.answer: Only for transactions outside the automatic route.

faqs.question: What happens on delayed filing?
faqs.answer: Late submission fees or compounding may apply.

SEBI Registration.shortDescription: Obtain SEBI registration to operate as a regulated securities market intermediary or entity.
SEBI Registration.longDescription: SEBI registration authorizes entities such as investment advisers, brokers, and portfolio managers to operate in the securities market. We manage eligibility review, documentation, and application filing.
benefits: Legal authorization to operate in securities market

process.title: Eligibility Review
process.description: Assess category-specific eligibility criteria.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application with required documents.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Respond to SEBI queries and obtain registration.

faqs.question: Who needs SEBI registration?
faqs.answer: Intermediaries like brokers, advisers, and portfolio managers.

faqs.question: Is net worth a mandatory criterion?
faqs.answer: Yes, minimum net worth varies by category of registration.

faqs.question: Does registration need renewal?
faqs.answer: Depends on category; some require periodic renewal.

IRDAI Registration.shortDescription: Get IRDAI registration or approval to operate as an insurance entity or intermediary in compliance with regulations.
IRDAI Registration.longDescription: IRDAI registration governs insurers, brokers, and other insurance intermediaries, ensuring compliance with licensing and consumer-protection norms. We manage documentation and application coordination.

process.title: Eligibility Assessment
process.description: Review category-specific IRDAI requirements.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application with supporting documents.

process.title: Approval Process
process.description: Address IRDAI queries and secure registration.

faqs.question: Who needs IRDAI registration?
faqs.answer: Insurers, brokers, corporate agents, and other insurance intermediaries.

faqs.question: Is minimum capital required?
faqs.answer: Yes, capital requirements vary by entity category.

faqs.question: How often is renewal required?
faqs.answer: Typically every 3 years, subject to category-specific rules.

RBI Licence/Registration.shortDescription: Obtain RBI licensing or registration to conduct regulated financial activities like lending or payments.
RBI Licence/Registration.longDescription: Entities engaged in banking, NBFC lending, or payment services require RBI authorization. We manage eligibility assessment, capital compliance, and detailed application filing.
benefits: Legal authorization for regulated finance activities

process.title: Eligibility Assessment
process.description: Confirm capital and category-specific eligibility.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit detailed application with business plan.

process.title: RBI Review & Approval
process.description: Respond to queries and secure licence.

faqs.question: What entities need RBI licensing?
faqs.answer: NBFCs, payment aggregators, and other regulated financial entities.

faqs.question: Is minimum net owned funds required?
faqs.answer: Yes, thresholds vary by category of licence.

faqs.question: How long is the approval process?
faqs.answer: It can range from a few months to over a year depending on category.

Tourism Registration.shortDescription: Register your tourism business to meet state tourism policy, safety, and quality requirements.
Tourism Registration.longDescription: Tourism registration recognizes eligible tour operators, travel agencies, and hospitality providers under state tourism department norms. We manage documentation and application filing.

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Identify applicable registration category.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application with the tourism department.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Receive registration certificate.

faqs.question: Who should register with tourism authorities?
faqs.answer: Tour operators, travel agents, and eligible hospitality providers.

faqs.question: Is registration state-specific?
faqs.answer: Yes, rules and categories vary by state tourism policy.

faqs.question: Does registration unlock scheme benefits?
faqs.answer: Yes, including promotional and subsidy schemes for tourism businesses.

Hotel/Restaurant Licence.shortDescription: Secure all required local and sectoral licences to legally operate your hotel or restaurant business.
Hotel/Restaurant Licence.longDescription: Hospitality establishments require multiple approvals covering health, fire safety, food, and municipal norms. We coordinate the full set of licences needed for smooth operation.
features: FSSAI, health, and fire NOC coordination
benefits: Reduces risk of closure or penalty

process.title: Licence Mapping
process.description: Identify all licences applicable to the establishment.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: File applications across relevant departments.

process.title: Approvals & Compliance
process.description: Track and secure all required licences.

faqs.question: What licences does a restaurant typically need?
faqs.answer: FSSAI, trade licence, health licence, and fire NOC, among others.

faqs.question: Is a liquor licence separate?
faqs.answer: Yes, it must be applied for separately if alcohol is served.

faqs.question: How long does full licensing take?
faqs.answer: Typically 30-60 days depending on jurisdiction and licence type.

Liquor Licence.shortDescription: Obtain the excise liquor licence required to manufacture, distribute, store, or sell alcoholic beverages.
Liquor Licence.longDescription: Liquor licensing is tightly regulated under state excise laws with category-specific conditions. We manage documentation, premises compliance, and coordination with the excise department.
benefits: Legal authorization to deal in alcohol

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Identify applicable liquor licence category.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application to state excise department.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Coordinate inspection and secure licence.

faqs.question: Is liquor licensing state-specific?
faqs.answer: Yes, rules, fees, and categories vary significantly by state.

faqs.question: Is a security deposit required?
faqs.answer: Yes, most states require a refundable security deposit.

faqs.question: How often is renewal required?
faqs.answer: Annually, in most states.

GeM Seller Registration.shortDescription: Register as a seller on the Government e-Marketplace to access transparent government procurement opportunities.
GeM Seller Registration.longDescription: GeM registration enables businesses to list products/services for government buyers, participate in bidding, and receive orders and payments through the portal. We manage profile setup and catalogue listing.

process.title: Profile Setup
process.description: Create and verify seller profile on GeM.

process.title: Catalogue Listing
process.description: List products/services with specifications and pricing.

process.title: Activation
process.description: Complete compliance steps and go live for bidding.

faqs.question: Is GST mandatory for GeM registration?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, except for specific exempted categories.

faqs.question: Is there a registration fee?
faqs.answer: Caution money may apply depending on seller category and turnover.

faqs.question: How are payments processed?
faqs.answer: Through the GeM portal with defined payment timelines after delivery.

NSIC-related Registration/Benefits.shortDescription: Access NSIC registration to unlock government procurement, tender, and credit-support benefits for MSMEs.
NSIC-related Registration/Benefits.longDescription: NSIC registration under the Single Point Registration Scheme helps MSMEs access tender exemptions, credit facilitation, and technical assistance. We manage eligibility assessment and application filing.
benefits: Access to credit and raw-material support

process.title: Eligibility Review
process.description: Assess MSME status and scheme eligibility.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application with supporting documents.

process.title: Registration Approval
process.description: Receive NSIC registration certificate.

faqs.question: Who can apply for NSIC registration?
faqs.answer: Udyam-registered micro and small enterprises.

faqs.question: What is the Single Point Registration Scheme?
faqs.answer: It enables EMD exemption and tender participation benefits for MSMEs.

faqs.question: Does the certificate need renewal?
faqs.answer: Yes, typically every 1-2 years based on turnover.

Startup/State-specific Incentives Regist.shortDescription: Access state-specific subsidies, reimbursements, and incentives available to eligible startups and businesses.
Startup/State-specific Incentives Regist.longDescription: Many states offer additional incentives beyond central schemes, including capital subsidies, SGST reimbursement, and employment incentives. We assess eligibility and manage the application process.
benefits: Access to capital and interest subsidies

process.title: Scheme Mapping
process.description: Identify applicable state incentive schemes.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application to the state nodal agency.

process.title: Approval & Disbursement
process.description: Follow up until incentive approval.

faqs.question: Are incentives the same across states?
faqs.answer: No, schemes and benefits vary significantly by state policy.

faqs.question: Can I combine state and central incentives?
faqs.answer: In many cases yes, subject to specific scheme conditions.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum investment requirement?
faqs.answer: Some schemes require minimum investment or employment thresholds.

Electricity/Power-related Approvals.shortDescription: Secure electricity connection approvals covering sanctioned load, installation, and metering requirements.
Electricity/Power-related Approvals.longDescription: Commercial and industrial power connections require approval covering load sanctioning, safety compliance, and metering infrastructure. We manage application filing and coordination with the electricity board.

process.title: Load Assessment
process.description: Determine sanctioned load requirement.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application to the electricity board.

process.title: Connection Approval
process.description: Coordinate inspection and receive connection.

faqs.question: Is a wiring certificate mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, from a licensed electrical contractor before connection.

faqs.question: How is sanctioned load determined?
faqs.answer: Based on total connected equipment load and future requirement.

faqs.question: Can sanctioned load be increased later?
faqs.answer: Yes, through a separate load-enhancement application.

Environmental/EC Approvals.shortDescription: Obtain Environmental Clearance assessing your project's impact on pollution, resources, and ecology.
Environmental/EC Approvals.longDescription: Environmental Clearance is mandatory for specified categories of projects before construction or expansion. We manage impact assessment coordination, documentation, and application filing with environmental authorities.

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Determine EC category and applicable authority.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit application with impact assessment documents.

process.title: Clearance Approval
process.description: Coordinate hearings/reviews and secure clearance.

faqs.question: Which projects need EC?
faqs.answer: Projects under Schedule categories of the EIA notification, such as mining and large construction.

faqs.question: Is public hearing always required?
faqs.answer: Only for Category A and certain Category B1 projects.

faqs.question: How long is clearance valid?
faqs.answer: Typically 7-10 years depending on project type.
